title: Give a Dog a Bone
content: I want to paint a portrait of Smooth, the husky mix. I give him a bone, and maybe he'll stay in one place.Well, he doesn't hold still, but the bone occupies his attention.Here's a video showing the process.Video link to YT-----Tutorial video downloads:Painting Animals from LifeandCasein in the WildHow to Make a Sketch Easel(DVD)Pentalic 5 x 8 inch Aqua JournalCasein Explorer's Set (12 colors)Casein 6-pack with brushes
